newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MILDLY FIRMER ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MILDLY FIRMER ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabe dollar drifted to a marginally firmer close on key currencies after a volatile Thursday morning session sparked by a short interbank market.
Foreign exchange dealers said rates steadied later in the day on the back of some export receipt inflows.

"There were some customers who were shopping around for dollars and the (Zimbabwe) dollar steadied. Imports were being absorbed and we're now generally net receivers of foreign exchange," one dealer said.
Towards the day's close, the local unit was indicated at 11.2750/2850 against the U.S. dollar versus 11.2775/2875 late Wednesday.

On the crosses, it was quoted at 18.2850/3300 on sterling compared to 18.2932/3207 and at 2.5266/5340 on the rand versus 2.5428/5468 but was a tad softer on the mark at 6.5655/5800 versus 6.5624/5701.
